description: Source code for the 'Account' doctype in ERPNext, defining the Account class with validation, creation, and update methods, as well as utility functions for account management.

classes.name: RootNotEditable
classes.description: Custom validation error for attempting to edit root account.

classes.name: BalanceMismatchError
classes.description: Custom validation error for balance mismatch scenarios.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Main class representing an accounting account with methods for validation, creation, and management.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles logic when an account is updated, including nested set updates.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets permissions or flags when the account is loaded.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a unique name for the account based on account number, name, and company.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving the account.

methods.name: set_root_and_report_type
methods.description: Sets report and root types based on parent account.

methods.name: validate_root_details
methods.description: Ensures root account constraints are met.

methods.name: validate_root_company_and_sync_account_to_children
methods.description: Validates and synchronizes account with company hierarchy.

methods.name: validate_group_or_ledger
methods.description: Validates whether account can be converted between group and ledger.

methods.name: validate_frozen_accounts_modifier
methods.description: Checks if frozen account status change is authorized.

methods.name: convert_group_to_ledger
methods.description: Converts a group account to a ledger account.

methods.name: convert_ledger_to_group
methods.description: Converts a ledger account to a group account.

methods.name: check_gle_exists
methods.description: Checks if there are existing GL entries for the account.

methods.name: check_if_child_exists
methods.description: Checks if the account has child accounts.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Validates mandatory fields like root_type and report_type.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles logic when an account is deleted, including checks for transactions.
